content:
Anna (partnerships): FYI — ACME private offer kickoff. Request from their procurement: want faster ROI so they're pushing for onboarding credits and an early-renewal incentive. Can we brainstorm options?
Sam (enterprise-sales): Are we thinking usage credits that vest as they hit adoption milestones? e.g., $X credits at 20%, 50%, 80% of expected usage.
Miguel (go-to-market): Yes — 'usage accelerators' have worked. Keep them time-bound (first 90 days) so it's predictable. Also need a renewal ETA and tie a small additional discount for >12mo renewal signed 60 days early.
Lina (finance): Need to be careful with list price protection — marketplace takes 5-10% fee, so our net effective discount must factor that. Suggest cap accelerator at 15% of first-year ARR equivalent.
Jae (solutions-eng): From SE side, we can include a free SI integration credit for the first 3 onboarding workshops (to remove friction). That should increase activation velocity.
Sam (enterprise-sales): Important: procurement asked for convertibility of unused credits to committed spend on renewal. Are we ok with that?
Lina (finance): Convertibility is fine if we 1) limit lookback window (90 days) and 2) require renewal >= 80% of original committed spend. Otherwise we expose churn.
Miguel (go-to-market): Recommend structure: 1) Onboarding credits: up to 12% first-year usage credits unlocked at 30/60/90 days; 2) Early renewal bonus: additional 2% discount if renewal signed >=60 days before EOY; 3) SI co-sell credit: one-time $Y to partner for integration milestones.
Anna (partnerships): Does that play with cloud marketplace private offers? marketplace-bot, any restrictions?
marketplace-bot: FYI — marketplace private offers can include promotional credits. Credits must be documented in the private offer terms and cannot exceed seller-specified monetary caps. Billing reconciliation must map credits to SKU lines.
Lina (finance): Good. Add clause: unused credits expire at end of year and cannot be refunded unless rolled into committed renewal subject to approval.
Sam (enterprise-sales): For ACME negotiation, can we offer a 6-month pilot paid at 50% with credits applied, then true-up at renewal? That's what procurement prefers.
Miguel (go-to-market): Pilot paid partially OK. But require minimum usage threshold to avoid gaming. If they don't hit threshold, credits reduce pro-rata.
Jae (solutions-eng): I'll draft a short checklist for partner onboarding workshops and what counts as milestone completion.
Anna (partnerships): Great — action items: Miguel to draft offer template, Lina to run financial cap calc, Jae to make onboarding checklist, Sam to confirm procurement askback. I'll collate and send to ACME by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
Sam (enterprise-sales): Will do. Thanks everyone.
Lina (finance): I'll post the cap numbers in this thread once calc done.
Miguel (go-to-market): One more thought — flag to legal: include a clawback if customer demonstrably reduces usage after early renewal that was incentivized by credits.
Anna (partnerships): Noted, will loop legal in next email.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: create private offer in console and attach "promotion_credit" SKU to track usage credits.
Anna (partnerships): Perfect. Closing loop once we have draft.
